title: Station Zero
blurb: Floor two. The track log starts at post three, but the cart leaves from post zero, and the stretch in between is unmapped: the Burrower lives there. Find the slope, walk back to zero for the start, and write the rule.
note: Captions stay on. It opens on the fake Station Zero, then goes back five minutes. Pause after Marcus says "First row. Ten!" and ask what the incident slip will say. Pause before he walks back into the tunnel and ask the class to walk it back with him: post 2, post 1, post 0. At the end, check the rule against post 9 together.
